cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: The Conspiracy Expands
cards.instruction: Use every denial, coincidence, and missing detail as proof that more people and higher stakes are involved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll trace our missing toaster receipt. The shop must have someone inside this house.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I probably recycled it. We can get a copy.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: All right, you get the copy. I'll check which recycling crew is removing originals for them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Every shop? Keep your copy. I'll photograph our other receipts before the whole high street wipes our warranties.

reason: Convert B copy solution into real delegated help and A own follow-up; each ordinary fact still enlarges the conspiracy, without detached declarations of control.
